title: Design skills static audit
coverage: 536 existing exact primary/supporting paths selected from a 2034-record registry; 13 skill families inspected in detail. Inventory scanner blocked by missing PyYAML; no skill workflows executed.

evidence.excerpt: Run `$impeccable shape` and wait for explicit brief confirmation.

findings.preserve: Clarify unresolved material scope; load real context and inspect rendered output.

findings.finding: Optional nested-card architecture becomes compulsory in protocol and checklist.

findings.preserve: Explicit preset selection, depth examples and responsive safeguards.

findings.finding: Mandatory Framer Motion, perpetual effects and dashboard-serif bans conflict with preserving the selected GSAP/editorial project; transition all conflicts with transform/opacity guidance.

evidence.excerpt: Use transition: all 0.3s ... Focus strictly on transform and opacity.

findings.preserve: Opt-in preset, dependency verification, state design and mobile fallback.

findings.finding: Relative helper command does not distinguish skill directory from target app cwd.
findings.preserve: Live registry fetch, body validation, licensing, prop inspection and no overwrite.

fix_now.reason: Resolve evidenced internal contradictions and helper path ambiguities; synchronize user-maintained copies only.
